assertions.name: the (2,1) block is the unique chirality cell (c_λ=0, D_q²=0) for H₃

description: Pins the H₂S +2.1° chiral residue to the framework's exact chirality machinery. The chirality cell is the Wedderburn block with signed content c_λ=0 (q-Dirac kernel D_q²=[c_λ]_q²=0): for H₃ this is exactly the (2,1) standard block (sym (3) c=+3, alt (1,1,1) c=−3) — the block the chiral p-orbital occupies. The residue is the braid holonomy ρ(β) around the singular fibre = the q-deformed Chern–Simons holonomy of a Wilson loop in S³. So the +2.1° = the S³ holonomy phase of the chiral p-lone on the c_λ=0 (2,1) cell; the exact angle is the monodromy phase around ζ_ℓ, the remaining compute.

data.finding: The H₂S chiral residue is pinned to the framework's chirality marker: the chiral channel is EXACTLY the (2,1) Wedderburn block with signed content c_λ=0 (the q-Dirac kernel D_q²=[c_λ]_q²=0; sym (3) c=+3, alt (1,1,1) c=−3) — the block the chiral p-orbital occupies. Per residue-as-braid-holonomy, the residue is the holonomy ρ(β) of the braid loop around the singular fibre ζ_ℓ = the q-deformed Chern–Simons holonomy of a Wilson loop in S³. So the +2.1° is the S³ holonomy phase of the chiral p-lone on the (2,1) cell. The exact value is the monodromy phase around ζ_ℓ — the remaining compute; the channel (c_λ=0 (2,1), S³ holonomy) is now exactly identified.
